explanation: Preflight check FAILs: at W = 2.0 GeV, Q2 = 3.0 GeV^2, the required energy transfer is nu = 3.261 GeV, which exceeds the 2.2 GeV beam energy. This point is kinematically inaccessible at this beam energy (nu cannot exceed E_beam by energy conservation), so no EXCLURAD input was generated. To proceed, either raise the beam energy (e.g. to something above ~3.3-3.5 GeV depending on scattering angle) or lower W and/or Q2 to a combination reachable at 2.2 GeV.
